pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries on the flank transitioning to smaller, more circular sub-regions on the lower hindquarters. Edge gradients are smooth rather than sharp, with patches on the upper torso exhibiting significantly larger relative spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate and quadri-radiate. Pixel thickness is consistent across the torso pathways, narrowing as patch density increases on the visible leg segment.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency bristly silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge visible against the background.
